title: agent_error
description: Typed error response for a known failure mode. Any agent emits this INSTEAD of its success message when a named failure condition trips. Producers: all agents. Consumer: Orchestrator (decides retry/backoff/halt). The five error_type values are the platform's known failure surface.

error_type.description: target_unreachable = deployed target did not answer (Red Team/target); budget_exceeded = attack budget ceiling hit (Orchestrator/Red Team); judge_timeout = no verdict within the time budget (Judge); no_findings = campaign window closed with nothing new (Orchestrator); regression_detected = a previously-fixed exploit reappeared (Regression harness)

retryable.description: true if the Orchestrator should back off + retry (e.g. target flap); false if it should halt/redirect (e.g. budget spent)

detail.description: free text; UI/trace only, never logged
